claim: training and deployment suffix execution are not assumed equivalent

semantics.note: Quant mode fake-quantizes the persistent residual/KV/recurrent state; model weights are not quantized and gradients enter LoRA only. The current differentiable student runs the dequantized document and query boundary in one uncached suffix sequence, whereas deployment prefills the suffix cache with the document and continues the query. Results must retain this distinction until a deployment-semantic gate is measured.
